curation_scope: Public RNA chemical-modification metadata registry; no sequence values, model execution or experimental protocols.
count_caveat: Evidence URLs and registry records are not counts of independent studies or additive biological observations.
material_findings: GSE90963 is simultaneous RBS-Seq of m5C, pseudouridine and m1A, not Nm-seq.
GSE225614 is mixed DNA/RNA UBS-seq; only its RNA subset belongs in RNA modification integration.
GSE240569 is pluripotent-cell/cardiomyocyte RNA bisulfite profiling with expression companions.
GSE212210 is PRAISE pseudouridine mapping with source IVT and enzyme-perturbation controls.
Nm-Mut-seq cannot detect Um; that absence is an assay blind spot.
Nm-seq has a correction addressing adaptor-related artifacts; file versions remain unverified.
Latest MODOMICS imports filtered long-RNA annotations; displayed unannotated bases are not validated unmodified negatives.
Sample2019 chemistry classes were confirmed in live sample metadata; MRL is distinct from direct protein abundance and decay.
No independently verified source release named m6AVar2 was identified; m6AVar and RMVar 2.0 are recorded under verified names.
RNA004 PRJEB91026 is a modification benchmark; PRJEB90280 is SeqTagger demultiplexing training data.
boundaries: No biological data table rows, reference sequences, sequencing reads, raw signals, model weights or source PDFs were downloaded to the registry.
GEO SOFT and ENA XML inspections were limited to selected public metadata fields.
No data-export license was inferred from an article or code license; NanoBaseLib's author-stated processed-data license is separately documented.
Legacy/current endpoint failures are retained in each record rather than treated as confirmed file availability.
